summary: Former tower site in Fayette County, WV (US 1666, WV 57); register says the tower was relocated to Peters Mountain, Monroe County; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: The register says the tower moved to Peters Mountain in Monroe County; no source we read says what stands at either site now.

events.note: Tower served by telephone from the Montgomery central office
$400 appropriated to build living quarters for the observer at Stop Knob

corrections.why: The register says the tower was relocated to Peters Mountain in Monroe County; the state list marks only the original site gone.
The register misspells the agency name; the Forest Lookouts page spells it correctly.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The state list marks the Stop Knob site gone, while the register says the tower moved to Peters Mountain. The story follows the register and reports both.
The AP story says the cabin was rebuilt in 1997; the register says the tower was reconstructed in 1999. The story reports both and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: The register's relocation to Peters Mountain is not tied to a structure: neither the register nor the state list names the tower now there. The state list has a separate row, Peters Mountain, Monroe County, Tower, Gone, with no register number; it may be connected but no source says so. The relocation has no year in any source, so it is not in events; fact status carries it. The register misspells the agency name (corrections). The brief's status gone is corrected to relocated by the register text. Access is unknown; no access field set. Two WebSearch queries were run; no new Stop Knob sources surfaced.
